default.title: Test-store shipping and printer setup
default.summary: ClawPilot now makes Shopify test-store activation, cart-rate callbacks, guarded UPS label testing, package setup, and local printer pairing clearer and recoverable.
features: Deleted starter packaging assortments can be intentionally recreated with fresh material identities and audit evidence
Shopify fulfillment and tracking activation remain independently selectable when checkout-rate callbacks still need a registered CarrierService
Shopify cart and checkout rates can use one selected UPS or FedEx sandbox account, or both, through an explicit CarrierService POST callback that is separate from event webhooks

The exact trusted Railway development service can exercise the LIVE UPS production-label path under the same Active Operations, sender-account, authorization, confirmation, audit, and void safeguards used for production
Printer settings distinguish a configured local printer from an agent that has actually connected
Mac pairing keeps each workspace credential and printer endpoint local while allowing one physical printer to serve separately enrolled workspaces
fixes: A stale starter-assortment receipt no longer reports deleted packages as available
UPS live-postage readiness returns a precise blocked response instead of an opaque server error, while TEST and LIVE selections continue to route only to their fixed sandbox and production APIs
Durable print jobs fail closed until the assigned local print agent records its first heartbeat
Local print acknowledgements use opaque device references instead of persisting or displaying raw printer hostnames and IP addresses
A lost print acknowledgement response no longer downgrades a locally delivered artifact or permits an automatic resend
